items.name: general-rag-system
items.description: A RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) knowledge base system with Vue.js frontend, Spring Boot backend, and FastAPI LLM service.

items.name: knowledge-base
items.description: Knowledge Copilot is a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) application with multi tenant isolation based on  LDAP for companies.  It allows organizations to interact with their private document libraries securely,  providing accurate answers with transparent quality scoring, source citations and traceability.

items.name: RAGknowledge_base
items.description: 一款基于langchain4j社区1.4.0版本+springboot3.5.5版本+milvus向量存储+七牛云（本地上传均可）实现的个人知识库问答系统。A personal knowledge base Q&A system implemented based on LangChain4j Community Edition (Version 1.4.0), Spring Boot (Version 3.5.5), Milvus vector storage, and Qiniu Cloud (with local upload also supported).

items.name: ai-knowledge-base
items.description: AI 知识库问答系统（RAG + LangChain4J）  > 基于 LangChain4J + Spring Boot 3.4 构建的企业级 RAG 知识库问答系统，支持多模型热切换、向量混合检索、流式输出，并集成完整的监控、测试、容器化方案。

items.name: enterprise-rag-stack
items.description: Full-stack Enterprise Knowledge Base & RAG platform with hybrid search (Elasticsearch + Neo4j Graph-RAG), dynamic multi-model routing via LangChain4j, and end-to-end document management. Built on Spring Cloud microservices (Java 21) and React 18.

items.name: My-Knowledge-Base
items.description: 基于 Spring Boot + React/Vite + Dify 的 AI 知识库问答平台，支持文档上传、OCR 入库与来源问答。

items.name: ai-code-helper
items.description: A Java-based AI Agent and RAG demo powered by Spring Boot and LangChain4j, featuring knowledge retrieval, tool calling, MCP web search, conversation memory, guardrails, and SSE streaming.

items.name: rag-knowledge-base
items.description: 基于 Spring Boot 3 与 Spring AI 的企业知识库 RAG 问答系统，支持文档上传、全文检索与引用溯源。

items.name: rag-knowledge-base
items.description: RAG智能知识库问答系统 — 模块化单体架构，Spring Boot 3 + Vue3 + Milvus + MySQL，央国企求职作品集项目

items.name: ai-knowledge-base
items.description: A Spring Boot RAG knowledge base with document parsing, pgvector, Ollama embeddings, streaming OpenRouter chat, Redis and web search.
